messages:
incident-bot: DETECTED - metering anomaly: token_count_delta spike across ingress pipelines. Pager triggered to #incidents at 23:18 UTC. alert_id=met-239876; severity=high :rotating_light:
oncall-ml: picking this up. seeing a sustained +12-18% token overcount on prod-ingest between 23:05-23:15 UTC. streaming window queue length normal.
Nina K.: adding notes — we pushed quantization change v3.2.1 to serving at 22:58. could be related to new tokenization alignment?
Jeremy L.: quick check: the metering proxy emitted duplicate ACKs at 23:07 due to tcp retry storm from one host (10.4.3.22). I isolated and blackholed that host from the proxy group.
oncall-ml: thanks. can we confirm whether duplicates are at ingress (pre-agg) or post-agg?
Jeremy L.: initial sampling of raw events shows duplicates pre-agg, looks like same request_id seen twice with identical token_delta. sample SQL below:
```sql
SELECT request_id, count(*) as c FROM raw_metering_events
WHERE ts >= '2026-03-14T23:00:00Z' AND ts <= '2026-03-14T23:20:00Z'
GROUP BY request_id HAVING c > 1 LIMIT 20;
```
A bunch of results returned.
Aisha (Billing): immediate ask — can we pause overage alerts and billing exports for the affected window? We are starting to get automated flagging to customers. Need to avoid false charges. :pray:
Ravi (CS Ops): customers pinging CS on flagged overages. please confirm pause asap, we need a short note to send to impacted accounts.
Sam A.: oncall-ml, I can take the billing-side ops. Steps: 1) disable overage alerts for the 23:00-23:20 window 2) stop the billing export job 3) trigger reconcile with dedupe logic. I need a thumbs up from Aisha.
Aisha (Billing): do it. disable alerts and stop exports now. add a short audit log entry referencing incident met-239876.
oncall-ml: mitigation plan:
- short-term: pause billing exports + mute overage alerts (Aisha/Sam)
- mid-term (1h): run dedupe reconcile job against raw events and recompute token aggregates for window
- long-term: add idempotency at metering proxy level + harden TCP retry/backoff on that host group
Nina K.: noted. I'm pulling the tokenization diffs between v3.1.9 and v3.2.1; will confirm if token_count serialization changed.
Jeremy L.: creating a patch to drop duplicate request_id at proxy ingress as temporary safeguard. pushing now to canary (proxy-canary-2).
oncall-ml: status update 23:35 UTC — proxy patch deployed to canary, duplicates reduced in canary stream. still seeing duplicates in main pool.
Sam A.: bill export stopped, alerting muted, audit log: "muted by Sam A. for incident met-239876 - pausing exports and alerts until reconcile". Posting note to #billing-ops.
Ravi (CS Ops): prepping customer message. draft: "We observed a metering discrepancy affecting a subset of usage records between 23:00-23:20 UTC on 2026-03-14. We have paused alerting and are reconciling counts — there will be no billing impact while we complete verification." Want to add anything Aisha?
Aisha (Billing): add ETA: preliminary recon is ~45-60m. mention next update in 30m. good to go.
Nina K.: found one suspicious change: tokenizer now emits composite token spans for emojis which were previously counted as single token. Could account for ~3-5% but not the full 12-18%. So root cause is likely the duplicate events + small tokenization delta.
oncall-ml: running reconcile dry-run now. command: `./tools/reconcile -s 2026-03-14T23:00:00Z -e 2026-03-14T23:20:00Z --dedupe request_id`
(doing a 10% sample to estimate runtime)
Jeremy L.: rolling proxy fix to main pool at 23:48 UTC, dropping duplicates at ingress.
oncall-ml: reconcile sample done — after dedupe counts reduce estimated overcount to ~4.2%. full run estimated 28m.
Sam A.: starting full reconcile job now. will post logs to S3: s3://redwood-incidents/met-239876/reconcile.log
Ravi (CS Ops): customer message posted to CS queue and sent to top-impacted accounts. copying support playbook entry here for edits.
Aisha (Billing): once reconcile completes, we'll compute delta and run a final verification before unmuting alerts. if delta < 1% we'll auto-clear. if >=1% we prepare crediting plan.
oncall-ml: reconcile finished 00:16 UTC — final deduped delta = 4.1% overcount for affected window.
Jeremy L.: root cause summary: transient TCP retry loop on proxy host 10.4.3.22 created duplicate event emission; a recent tokenizer change contributed minor variance. both fixed: host blackholed and proxy retry logic hardened; tokenizer revert candidate prepared for patching if we see continued drift.
Aisha (Billing): decision: do not bill the +4.1%. issue one-off corrections and re-run billing export for post-verified records. Sam, coordinate export resume.
Sam A.: will resume exports after billing-run-verify. scheduling run at 00:40 UTC.
Ravi (CS Ops): customer message update: "We completed verification and have adjusted affected usage records. No customer billing impact. Contact CS if you see anything off." sent at 00:45 UTC.
oncall-ml: incident handoff summary:
- incident_id: met-239876
- window: 2026-03-14T23:00:00Z - 2026-03-14T23:20:00Z
- cause: proxy tcp retry storm -> duplicate events + tokenizer minor change
- impact: temporary overage flags and potential false billing (mitigated)
- actions: paused alerts/exports, dedupe reconcile, host blackhole, proxy retry backoff, tokenizer review
- owners: Jeremy L. (infra), Nina K. (tokenizer), Sam A. (billing ops), Aisha (billing policy), Ravi (CS)
Please add any missed items. :heavy_check_mark:
